metadata.venue: MetLife Stadium, East Rutherford, New Jersey

ai_summary.key_headline: Deschamps' Final-Tournament Bleus Face Thiaw's Resurgent Lions

france.philosophy: High-transition direct attacking built around Mbappe and a fluid front line.

senegal.philosophy: High-intensity pressing with rapid wing transitions through Mane and Diatta.

tactical_insights: France will look to break Senegal's block through Tchouameni and Rabiot's progression to feed Dembele, Olise and Mbappe.
Senegal's Nicolas Jackson and Sadio Mane will target France's advanced fullbacks on counter-attacks.
The midfield battle between Tchouameni and Pape Gueye will dictate the tempo and possession share.
